instruments.title: Add LBF, SFS 2004:297
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1080

titles.en: Banking and Financing Business Act (2004:297)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep customers' dealings with the bank confidential
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 1 kap. 10 §

titles.en: Keep customers' dealings with the bank confidential

summaries.en: The institution and its staff must not disclose, without authority, information about an individual's relationship with the institution. The same protection covers information in an internal report of a suspected breach that could reveal who reported or who was reported.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hand over customer information to criminal investigators on request, without delay and electronically
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 1 kap. 11 §

titles.en: Hand over customer information to criminal investigators on request, without delay and electronically

summaries.en: When a head of a preliminary investigation or a prosecutor requests information about a customer's relationship with the institution in a criminal investigation, a forfeiture investigation, a request for mutual legal assistance or a European investigation order, the institution must provide it without delay and in electronic form.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run the business soundly so that the institution can always meet its obligations
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 6 kap. 1, 4, 4 a och 4 b §§

titles.en: Run the business soundly so that the institution can always meet its obligations

summaries.en: The institution must conduct its business so that its ability to meet its obligations is not put at risk, and must otherwise operate in a sound manner. The board is responsible for meeting these requirements, applied in proportion to the nature, scale and complexity of the business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify, measure, manage, report internally and control the risks of the business
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 6 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Identify, measure, manage, report internally and control the risks of the business

summaries.en: The institution must have risk management covering credit, market, operational and other risks and satisfactory internal control, so that the combined risks do not endanger its ability to meet its obligations. It must also draw up a recovery plan under chapter 6 a.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide a suitable internal channel for staff to report suspected breaches
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 6 kap. 2 b §

titles.en: Provide a suitable internal channel for staff to report suspected breaches

summaries.en: The institution must have appropriate reporting systems through which employees can report suspected breaches of the rules that apply to the institution's business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep depositor records that can produce a complete list of depositors without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 6 kap. 3 a §

titles.en: Keep depositor records that can produce a complete list of depositors without delay

summaries.en: The institution's systems for handling data on depositors and their deposits must allow it to compile, without delay, a complete and reliable list of all depositors and their respective deposits.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Cap variable pay for risk takers at the level of fixed pay
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 6 kap. 4 c §

titles.en: Cap variable pay for risk takers at the level of fixed pay

summaries.en: For an employee whose role or total pay means they can materially affect the institution's risk profile, variable remuneration may not exceed fixed remuneration.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep written internal policies and instructions and review them at least every two years
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 6 kap. 5 §

titles.en: Keep written internal policies and instructions and review them at least every two years

summaries.en: The board must ensure there are written internal guidelines and instructions to the extent needed to meet the soundness, risk and transparency requirements and otherwise steer the business, and that they are evaluated and reviewed at least every second year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Finansinspektionen before outsourcing licensed services and file the outsourcing agreement
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 6 kap. 7 §

titles.en: Notify Finansinspektionen before outsourcing licensed services and file the outsourcing agreement

summaries.en: Before the institution has someone else perform any of the financial services it is licensed for, it must notify Finansinspektionen and submit the agreement. The institution stays responsible to the customer, the provider must work under controlled and secure conditions, and the outsourcing must not stop the institution meeting its obligations.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Draw up and update a board-approved recovery plan and submit it to Finansinspektionen
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 6 a kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Draw up and update a board-approved recovery plan and submit it to Finansinspektionen

summaries.en: The institution must prepare a recovery plan, update it when needed, have it approved by the board and submit it to Finansinspektionen at the time the authority sets. An institution in a group under consolidated supervision is instead covered by a group recovery plan unless Finansinspektionen requires an individual plan.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess the borrower's ability to repay before granting credit
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 8 kap. 1, 2 och 4 §§

titles.en: Assess the borrower's ability to repay before granting credit

summaries.en: Before deciding to grant a credit, the institution must assess the risk that the obligations under the credit agreement will not be met and may grant the credit only if they can on good grounds be expected to be met. The decision-maker must have adequate decision support, and the same applies to credit-like exposures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document each credit decision and its basis
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 8 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Document each credit decision and its basis

summaries.en: Credit decisions must be documented so that the basis for the decision is shown and the handling of the credit case can be followed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Deal with board members, senior management and their related parties only on normal, arm's-length terms
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 8 kap. 5 och 6 §§

titles.en: Deal with board members, senior management and their related parties only on normal, arm's-length terms

summaries.en: The institution may not agree services on terms other than those it normally applies, or other agreements on non-commercial terms, with or for the benefit of board members, persons in senior positions and certain related persons and companies. The board must handle such matters and keep a list of the agreements made.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give Finansinspektionen the information about the business that it asks for
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:297, Lag (2004:297) om bank- och finansieringsrörelse, 13 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Give Finansinspektionen the information about the business that it asks for

summaries.en: The institution must provide Finansinspektionen with the information about its business and related circumstances that the authority requests.

instruments.title: Add LVM, SFS 2007:528
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1066

titles.en: Securities Market Act (2007:528)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the client's best interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 9 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the client's best interest

summaries.en: When providing investment or ancillary services, the firm must safeguard its clients' interests and act honestly, fairly and professionally, and otherwise behave so that public confidence in the securities market is maintained.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Categorise every client as professional or retail under documented internal rules
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 9 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Categorise every client as professional or retail under documented internal rules

summaries.en: The firm must classify its clients as professional or non-professional (retail) clients, may treat certain professional clients as eligible counterparties, and must have internal rules and procedures for the classification.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify, prevent and manage conflicts of interest with and between clients
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 9 kap. 9 §

titles.en: Identify, prevent and manage conflicts of interest with and between clients

summaries.en: The firm must take all reasonable steps to identify, prevent and manage conflicts of interest between itself, its tied agents and related persons and its clients, or between clients, including those arising from third-party payments, its own remuneration and other incentives. Where its arrangements are not enough, it must disclose the conflict to the client before acting.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run a product approval process with a defined target market for instruments the firm manufactures
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 8 kap. 13 § och 9 kap. 11 §

titles.en: Run a product approval process with a defined target market for instruments the firm manufactures

summaries.en: A firm that manufactures financial instruments for sale to clients must approve each instrument and each significant change before it is marketed or distributed, specify a target market of end clients, assess the relevant risks, check that the distribution strategy fits the target market and review its instruments regularly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Understand the instruments the firm distributes and offer them only where they serve the client's interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 9 kap. 12 §

titles.en: Understand the instruments the firm distributes and offer them only where they serve the client's interest

summaries.en: A distributing firm must know the instruments it offers or recommends, assess how they meet the needs of the clients it serves in light of the manufacturer's target market, and offer or recommend them only when this is in the client's interest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give clients clear, fair information on the firm, the instruments, execution venues and all costs in good time
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 9 kap. 14 och 15 §§

titles.en: Give clients clear, fair information on the firm, the instruments, execution venues and all costs in good time

summaries.en: Before providing a service, the firm must give clients appropriate, understandable information about itself and its services, the instruments and strategies proposed with their risks, execution venues, and all costs and charges. Everything it tells clients must be fair, clear and not misleading, and marketing must be identifiable as such.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept or pay third-party fees and benefits only when they enhance the service and are disclosed
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 9 kap. 21 §

titles.en: Accept or pay third-party fees and benefits only when they enhance the service and are disclosed

summaries.en: In connection with a service, the firm may pay or receive a fee or benefit to or from anyone other than the client only if it is designed to enhance the quality of the service, does not impair the duty to act in the client's best interest, and has been disclosed to the client in advance in a comprehensive, accurate and understandable way.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report to clients on a durable medium on the services provided, including costs
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 9 kap. 27 §

titles.en: Report to clients on a durable medium on the services provided, including costs

summaries.en: The firm must give each client adequate reports on a durable medium about the services carried out, periodically where relevant, including the costs of the transactions and services. For professional clients this applies only if the client asks, and the request must be documented.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Take all sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result when executing client orders
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 9 kap. 31 och 33 §§

titles.en: Take all sufficient steps to obtain the best possible result when executing client orders

summaries.en: When executing orders, the firm must take all steps needed to achieve the best possible result for the client, taking into account price, costs, speed, likelihood of execution and settlement, size, nature and other relevant factors, and must follow specific client instructions. It must have an order execution policy and systems, and monitor and update them regularly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Execute client orders promptly, efficiently and fairly in the order received
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 9 kap. 38 §

titles.en: Execute client orders promptly, efficiently and fairly in the order received

summaries.en: The firm must carry out client orders promptly, efficiently and fairly, without disadvantaging the client compared with other clients or the firm's own trading, and otherwise comparable orders must be executed in the order they were received unless there is reason to do otherwise.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record all investment services and transactions so that Finansinspektionen can supervise compliance
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 8 kap. 16 §

titles.en: Record all investment services and transactions so that Finansinspektionen can supervise compliance

summaries.en: The firm must document all its investment activities, investment and ancillary services and transactions in a way that lets Finansinspektionen check compliance with the act, MiFIR and the Market Abuse Regulation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Record telephone calls and keep electronic communications about client orders and own-account dealing
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 8 kap. 17 och 20 §§

titles.en: Record telephone calls and keep electronic communications about client orders and own-account dealing

summaries.en: Records must include recordings of telephone conversations and copies of electronic communications relating to own-account dealing and to receiving, transmitting and executing client orders, including communications intended to lead to such transactions. They must be kept for at least five years, or up to seven where rules so require, and made available to the client on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure that staff who advise or inform clients have the required knowledge and competence
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 8 kap. 15 §

titles.en: Ensure that staff who advise or inform clients have the required knowledge and competence

summaries.en: The firm must ensure, and be able to show Finansinspektionen on request, that people giving investment advice or information about instruments and services have the knowledge and competence the firm needs to meet its obligations.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain compliance policies and rules for staff's personal dealing
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2007:528, Lag (2007:528) om värdepappersmarknaden, 8 kap. 9 §

titles.en: Maintain compliance policies and rules for staff's personal dealing

summaries.en: The firm must establish and apply the guidelines and procedures needed for its board, employees and tied agents to comply with the rules governing the business, and rules for these persons' own transactions in financial instruments.

instruments.title: Add Lag med kompletterande bestämmelser till MAR, SFS 2016:1306
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1306, Lag (2016:1306) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s marknadsmissbruksförordning, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1074

titles.sv: Lag (2016:1306) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s marknadsmissbruksförordning
titles.en: Act (2016:1306) with supplementary provisions to the EU Market Abuse Regulation

payload.shortName: Lag med kompletterande bestämmelser till MAR

obligations.title: Add the duty: Explain to Finansinspektionen on request how the conditions for delaying disclosure of inside information were met
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1306, Lag (2016:1306) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s marknadsmissbruksförordning, 2 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Explain to Finansinspektionen on request how the conditions for delaying disclosure of inside information were met

summaries.en: An issuer that has delayed publishing inside information must, when Finansinspektionen asks, give the authority an explanation of how the conditions for delay under Article 17(4) of MAR were met.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give staff a suitable internal channel to report suspected breaches of MAR
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1306, Lag (2016:1306) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s marknadsmissbruksförordning, 2 kap. 7, 8 och 9 §§

titles.en: Give staff a suitable internal channel to report suspected breaches of MAR

summaries.en: A financial firm, including a bank, investment firm, fund manager or insurer as the act defines, must provide appropriate reporting systems for employees who want to report suspected infringements of the Market Abuse Regulation. The identity of the reporter and the reported person must be protected.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not reveal to a client or outsider that a suspicious transaction and order report has been filed
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1306, Lag (2016:1306) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s marknadsmissbruksförordning, 2 kap. 10 §

titles.en: Do not reveal to a client or outsider that a suspicious transaction and order report has been filed

summaries.en: A firm that has reported a suspicious order or transaction to Finansinspektionen under Article 16 of MAR, and its board members and employees, must not disclose without authority to the client or anyone else that the report has been made.

instruments.title: Add Lag om straff för marknadsmissbruk, SFS 2016:1307
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1307, Lag (2016:1307) om straff för marknadsmissbruk på värdepappersmarknaden, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1324

titles.sv: Lag (2016:1307) om straff för marknadsmissbruk på värdepappersmarknaden
titles.en: Act (2016:1307) on penalties for market abuse on the securities market

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not trade, amend orders or advise others on the basis of inside information
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1307, Lag (2016:1307) om straff för marknadsmissbruk på värdepappersmarknaden, 2 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Do not trade, amend orders or advise others on the basis of inside information

summaries.en: It is a crime for a person who has inside information to acquire or dispose of the financial instruments it concerns, or change or cancel an order in them, for their own or someone else's account, or to advise or induce someone else to do so. Legitimate behaviour under Article 9 of MAR and the act's other exceptions fall outside the offence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not disclose inside information outside the normal exercise of work or duties
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1307, Lag (2016:1307) om straff för marknadsmissbruk på värdepappersmarknaden, 2 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Do not disclose inside information outside the normal exercise of work or duties

summaries.en: It is a crime to disclose inside information, or to pass on advice or an inducement based on inside information, unless the disclosure happens as a normal part of carrying out one's employment, profession or duties.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not place orders, trade or spread information that gives false or misleading signals or fixes prices
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1307, Lag (2016:1307) om straff för marknadsmissbruk på värdepappersmarknaden, 2 kap. 4 och 5 §§

titles.en: Do not place orders, trade or spread information that gives false or misleading signals or fixes prices

summaries.en: It is a crime to carry out transactions, place orders or otherwise act in a way that gives false or misleading signals about the supply, demand or price of financial instruments, secures the price at an abnormal or artificial level, or otherwise manipulates the market as the act describes. Conduct in line with an accepted market practice and for legitimate reasons is not punishable.

instruments.title: Add Penningtvättslagen, SFS 2017:630
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1075

titles.sv: Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism
titles.en: Act (2017:630) on measures against money laundering and terrorist financing

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess how the firm's products and services could be used for money laundering or terrorist financing
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 2 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Assess how the firm's products and services could be used for money laundering or terrorist financing

summaries.en: The firm must carry out a general risk assessment of how its products and services can be misused for money laundering or terrorist financing and how large that risk is, considering in particular its products, customers, distribution channels and geographic risk factors. Its scope must match the size and nature of the business.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set a money laundering risk profile for every customer
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 2 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Set a money laundering risk profile for every customer

summaries.en: The firm must assess the risk of money laundering or terrorist financing associated with each customer relationship, based on the general risk assessment and what it knows about the customer, taking the listed lower and higher risk factors into account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not offer anonymous accounts, passbooks or safe deposit boxes
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 2 kap. 6 §

titles.en: Do not offer anonymous accounts, passbooks or safe deposit boxes

summaries.en: Credit and financial institutions covered by the act may not provide anonymous accounts, anonymous passbooks or anonymous safe deposit boxes.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep documented, risk-based procedures for due diligence, monitoring, reporting and data handling
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 2 kap. 8 §

titles.en: Keep documented, risk-based procedures for due diligence, monitoring, reporting and data handling

summaries.en: The firm must have documented procedures and guidelines for customer due diligence, monitoring and reporting and for processing personal data, adapt them continuously to new and changing risks, and size them to the business and the risks found in the general risk assessment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set and enforce group-wide AML procedures as the ultimate parent company
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 2 kap. 9, 10 och 11 §§

titles.en: Set and enforce group-wide AML procedures as the ultimate parent company

summaries.en: A firm that is the ultimate parent of a group must set common procedures and guidelines for the group, including on data protection and sharing information about suspected money laundering within the group, and ensure they are applied, including in subsidiaries and branches outside the EEA.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Vet and continuously train staff who work on preventing money laundering
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 2 kap. 13 och 14 §§

titles.en: Vet and continuously train staff who work on preventing money laundering

summaries.en: The firm must have procedures to check the suitability of employees, contractors and others whose tasks matter for preventing money laundering and terrorist financing, and must give them relevant training and information on an ongoing basis, covering at least the rules, the general risk assessment, the firm's procedures and how to spot suspicious activity.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Identify and verify the customer and understand the purpose of the relationship before doing business
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 3 kap. 1, 4, 7, 9 och 12 §§

titles.en: Identify and verify the customer and understand the purpose of the relationship before doing business

summaries.en: The firm must apply customer due diligence when establishing a business relationship and for occasional transactions at or above EUR 15 000, identify the customer and verify identity from reliable independent sources, complete verification before the relationship starts, and obtain information on the purpose and nature of the relationship. It may not establish or maintain a relationship or carry out a transaction without enough knowledge of the customer to manage the risk and monitor activity.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Find out whether the customer has a beneficial owner and verify that person's identity
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 3 kap. 8 §

titles.en: Find out whether the customer has a beneficial owner and verify that person's identity

summaries.en: The firm must investigate whether the customer has a beneficial owner, at least by searching the Swedish register of beneficial owners; for legal persons and arrangements it must understand the ownership and control structure, and it must take measures to verify the beneficial owner's identity.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Screen for politically exposed persons and apply the extra measures when one is found
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 3 kap. 10 och 19 §§

titles.en: Screen for politically exposed persons and apply the extra measures when one is found

summaries.en: The firm must determine whether the customer or its beneficial owner is a politically exposed person, a family member or a known close associate. If so, it must establish the source of the assets involved, apply enhanced ongoing monitoring and obtain approval from an authorised senior person before establishing or continuing the relationship.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep customer knowledge up to date throughout the business relationship
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 3 kap. 13 §

titles.en: Keep customer knowledge up to date throughout the business relationship

summaries.en: The firm must follow up ongoing business relationships regularly and when needed, so that what it knows about the customer, the beneficial owner, political exposure and the purpose of the relationship remains current and sufficient to manage the assessed risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply enhanced due diligence to high-risk customers and customers in high-risk third countries
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 3 kap. 16 och 17 §§

titles.en: Apply enhanced due diligence to high-risk customers and customers in high-risk third countries

summaries.en: Where the risk tied to a customer relationship is assessed as high, the firm must carry out especially extensive checks and add measures to counter the risk, such as further information on the customer's business, finances and source of funds. Enhanced measures are always required for customers established in a third country the European Commission has listed as high-risk.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Monitor relationships and transactions to detect activity that deviates from what is expected
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 4 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Monitor relationships and transactions to detect activity that deviates from what is expected

summaries.en: The firm must monitor ongoing business relationships and assess occasional transactions to detect activity and transactions that deviate from what it can expect from its knowledge of the customer or that otherwise may be linked to money laundering or terrorist financing, and must analyse any deviations with enhanced measures.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report suspected money laundering or terrorist financing to the Swedish Police without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 4 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Report suspected money laundering or terrorist financing to the Swedish Police without delay

summaries.en: If, after its assessment, the firm has reasonable grounds to suspect money laundering, terrorist financing or that property otherwise comes from crime, it must report all indicative circumstances to the Police Authority without delay, also when a transaction is not carried out or the suspicion arises before a relationship is established.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have a system that can quickly tell authorities whether a person has been a customer in the last five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 4 kap. 7 §

titles.en: Have a system that can quickly tell authorities whether a person has been a customer in the last five years

summaries.en: The firm must have a system allowing it to state quickly and completely whether it has had a business relationship with a given person during the past five years and, if so, the nature of the relationship.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not tell the customer or others that a suspicion is being examined or has been reported
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 4 kap. 9 §

titles.en: Do not tell the customer or others that a suspicion is being examined or has been reported

summaries.en: The firm and those working for it must not disclose without authority to the customer or anyone else that an assessment of suspicious activity is under way or has been carried out, or that information has been reported to the Police or provided on request. Sharing with supervisors, law enforcement and within the group as the act allows is not prohibited.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep due diligence records and transaction records for five years
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 5 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Keep due diligence records and transaction records for five years

summaries.en: The firm must keep documents and information on the customer due diligence measures taken and on transactions carried out with customers for five years, counted from when the measures or transactions were carried out or, for a business relationship, from when it ended.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint a responsible executive and a compliance officer and set up an independent audit function
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2017:630, Lag (2017:630) om åtgärder mot penningtvätt och finansiering av terrorism, 6 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Appoint a responsible executive and a compliance officer and set up an independent audit function

summaries.en: Where warranted by the size and nature of the business, the firm must appoint a member of senior management responsible for implementing the act, a central compliance officer who monitors compliance and files reports to the Police, and an independent audit function that reviews the internal guidelines, controls and procedures.

instruments.title: Add LBT, SFS 2010:751
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1068

titles.en: Payment Services Act (2010:751)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Safeguard funds received from payment service users
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 3 kap. 7 §

titles.en: Safeguard funds received from payment service users

summaries.en: A payment institution must protect users' funds received for payment transactions, either by keeping them segregated from its own assets and from funds held for others, or by covering them with an insurance policy or guarantee from an insurer or credit institution outside its group.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the user the prescribed information in good time before a framework contract is concluded
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 4 kap. 10 och 11 §§

titles.en: Give the user the prescribed information in good time before a framework contract is concluded

summaries.en: Before concluding a framework contract, the payment service provider must give the user information including its identity and authorisation, a description of the service, the data needed for correct execution, how consent is given and withdrawn, the maximum execution time, charges, interest and exchange rates, and the other matters the act lists. The information must be on paper or another durable medium and clear.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not refuse a consumer lawfully resident in the EEA a payment account with basic features
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 4 a kap. 1 och 3 §§

titles.en: Do not refuse a consumer lawfully resident in the EEA a payment account with basic features

summaries.en: A credit institution may not refuse a consumer who is lawfully resident in the EEA a payment account with the basic features it offers other consumers, unless that would breach the anti-money laundering act or there are special reasons. It must decide on a complete application promptly and at the latest within ten banking days, and explain a refusal and where to complain.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give consumers the fee information list before a payment account contract and fee information every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 4 a kap. 5 §

titles.en: Give consumers the fee information list before a payment account contract and fee information every year

summaries.en: Before concluding a payment account contract, the provider must give the consumer, on paper or another durable medium, the list of the most representative services linked to payment accounts with its fees for them, and keep the list and a glossary available. At least once a year it must give the consumer free information on the current fees and interest rates for the services linked to the account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have a switching procedure that moves a consumer's payment account quickly and without undue inconvenience
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 4 a kap. 6 §

titles.en: Have a switching procedure that moves a consumer's payment account quickly and without undue inconvenience

summaries.en: The provider must have procedures for a consumer to switch a payment account in the same currency to or from another Swedish provider quickly and without unnecessary inconvenience, inform consumers about them and, as receiving provider, contact the old provider on the consumer's request and see the switch through within the set time.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep personalised security credentials secret and let users report loss of a payment instrument at any time
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 5 kap. 5 §

titles.en: Keep personalised security credentials secret and let users report loss of a payment instrument at any time

summaries.en: The provider must set objective, non-discriminatory and proportionate conditions for payment instruments, not make personalised security credentials available to anyone but the user, not send unsolicited instruments, and make sure users can at any time notify loss, theft or misuse and ask to unblock the instrument.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Credit the payee's provider by the end of the next business day
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 5 kap. 40 §

titles.en: Credit the payee's provider by the end of the next business day

summaries.en: Once a payment order has been received, the payer's provider must ensure that the amount is credited to the payee's provider's account at the latest by the end of the following banking day, with one extra day for paper-initiated transactions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Refund an unauthorised transaction by the end of the next business day
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 5 a kap. 1 §

titles.en: Refund an unauthorised transaction by the end of the next business day

summaries.en: When an unauthorised transaction has been made from an account holder's account, the provider must restore the account to the position it would have been in, immediately and at the latest by the end of the banking day after it learned of the transaction, subject to the liability rules and a reasonable time to investigate if fraud by the holder is suspected.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report operational and security risks and fraud statistics to Finansinspektionen
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 5 b kap. 2 §

titles.en: Report operational and security risks and fraud statistics to Finansinspektionen

summaries.en: The provider must report to Finansinspektionen the operational and security risks of its payment services and the measures taken to manage them, and must provide statistical data on fraud connected with its payment services.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply strong customer authentication for online account access, electronic payments and risky remote actions
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 5 b kap. 4 §

titles.en: Apply strong customer authentication for online account access, electronic payments and risky remote actions

summaries.en: The provider must apply strong customer authentication when the payer accesses a payment account online, initiates an electronic payment transaction or carries out any remote action that may imply a risk of fraud or abuse. For remote electronic payments the authentication must be dynamically linked to the amount and payee.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let payment initiation and account information providers rely on the bank's authentication
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 5 b kap. 5 §

titles.en: Let payment initiation and account information providers rely on the bank's authentication

summaries.en: An account servicing provider that offers an online payment account must enable providers of payment initiation and account information services to rely on the authentication procedures it provides to its users.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide cash withdrawal, cash deposit and business cash deposit services across the country
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 9 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Provide cash withdrawal, cash deposit and business cash deposit services across the country

summaries.en: Credit institutions that had more than SEK 70 billion in deposits from the public on 1 July of the previous year must provide places for cash withdrawal and cash deposit for consumers with basic payment accounts, and for businesses to deposit daily takings, to a satisfactory extent throughout Sweden.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Show a payment option that does not involve credit first in online purchases
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:751, Lag (2010:751) om betaltjänster, 7 a kap. 1 §

titles.en: Show a payment option that does not involve credit first in online purchases

summaries.en: When a consumer buying online can choose a payment method that does not involve credit, the payment service provider must make sure that option is shown first, and a credit-based method may not be preselected if other methods exist.

instruments.title: Add LEP, SFS 2011:755
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:755, Lag (2011:755) om elektroniska pengar, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1069

titles.en: Electronic Money Act (2011:755)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Safeguard funds received in exchange for electronic money
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:755, Lag (2011:755) om elektroniska pengar, 3 kap. 7 och 8 §§

titles.en: Safeguard funds received in exchange for electronic money

summaries.en: An electronic money institution must protect the funds received for issued e-money, either by keeping them segregated from its own assets and from funds held for others, or by covering them with an insurance policy or guarantee from an insurer or credit institution outside its group, and must tell Finansinspektionen in advance of material changes to these arrangements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Issue electronic money at par value without delay on receipt of funds
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:755, Lag (2011:755) om elektroniska pengar, 4 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Issue electronic money at par value without delay on receipt of funds

summaries.en: Electronic money must be issued without delay at the same value as the funds received.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Agree and disclose the redemption conditions and fees before the holder is bound
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:755, Lag (2011:755) om elektroniska pengar, 4 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Agree and disclose the redemption conditions and fees before the holder is bound

summaries.en: The issuer and holder must enter into a contract that clearly states the conditions of redemption and any fees, and the holder is bound only once informed of these conditions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Redeem electronic money at par value whenever the holder asks
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:755, Lag (2011:755) om elektroniska pengar, 4 kap. 3 och 4 §§

titles.en: Redeem electronic money at par value whenever the holder asks

summaries.en: At the holder's request the issuer must redeem part or all of the outstanding electronic money at nominal value, and the whole amount if asked within a year after the contract ends. A redemption fee is allowed only if the contract provides for it and it reflects the issuer's reasonable costs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not pay interest or benefits linked to how long electronic money is held
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:755, Lag (2011:755) om elektroniska pengar, 4 kap. 5 §

titles.en: Do not pay interest or benefits linked to how long electronic money is held

summaries.en: An issuer of electronic money may not pay interest or grant any other benefit related to the length of time the holder keeps the electronic money.

instruments.title: Add KkrL, SFS 2010:1846
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:1846, Konsumentkreditlag (2010:1846), text as amended up to SFS 2026:249

titles.en: Consumer Credit Act (2010:1846)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Observe good lending practice and look after the consumer's interests
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:1846, Konsumentkreditlag (2010:1846), 6 §

titles.en: Observe good lending practice and look after the consumer's interests

summaries.en: The creditor must follow good credit-granting practice towards the consumer, safeguard the consumer's interests with due care and give the explanations the consumer needs, for mortgage credit including other services offered with the credit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Market credit moderately, with a representative example of the effective interest rate and a debt warning
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:1846, Konsumentkreditlag (2010:1846), 6 a, 7 och 7 b §§

titles.en: Market credit moderately, with a representative example of the effective interest rate and a debt warning

summaries.en: Credit marketing must be moderate, must state the effective interest rate with a representative example and, where other figures are given, further cost information, and must include a special notice that credit costs money, on the risks of indebtedness and where to get budget and debt advice.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer the prescribed pre-contract credit information in good time
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:1846, Konsumentkreditlag (2010:1846), 8 §

titles.en: Give the consumer the prescribed pre-contract credit information in good time

summaries.en: In good time before a credit agreement is concluded, the creditor must give the consumer, on paper or another durable medium, the prescribed information about the type of credit, the parties, amount, term, costs, effective interest rate and other key terms.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Grant credit only after an assessment shows the consumer can repay
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:1846, Konsumentkreditlag (2010:1846), 12 §

titles.en: Grant credit only after an assessment shows the consumer can repay

summaries.en: The creditor must assess whether the consumer has the financial means to meet the credit obligations, on the basis of sufficient information about the consumer's finances, grant the credit only if so, and reassess before any significant increase in the credit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document the credit agreement in a durable form with the prescribed particulars
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:1846, Konsumentkreditlag (2010:1846), 14 §

titles.en: Document the credit agreement in a durable form with the prescribed particulars

summaries.en: The creditor must record the credit agreement on paper or another durable medium accessible to the consumer, including the contract terms and the prescribed particulars such as the effective interest rate.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep interest and total credit costs within the statutory caps
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:1846, Konsumentkreditlag (2010:1846), 19 a och 19 b §§

titles.en: Keep interest and total credit costs within the statutory caps

summaries.en: The credit interest and default interest per year may not exceed the reference rate plus 20 percentage points, and total credit costs, including default interest and collection costs, may not exceed the amount of the credit.

instruments.title: Add Konsumentkreditlagen (2026:1011), SFS 2026:1011
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:1011, Konsumentkreditlag (2026:1011), text as issued

titles.en: Consumer Credit Act (2026:1011)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act in line with good lending practice and look after the consumer's interests
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:1011, Konsumentkreditlag (2026:1011), 1 kap. 9 §

titles.en: Act in line with good lending practice and look after the consumer's interests

summaries.en: The trader must act towards the consumer in accordance with good credit-granting practice and carefully safeguard the consumer's interests.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Market credit moderately and without wording that downplays debt or presents credit as savings
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:1011, Konsumentkreditlag (2026:1011), 2 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Market credit moderately and without wording that downplays debt or presents credit as savings

summaries.en: Credit marketing must be moderate and must not create false expectations about availability or cost, suggest that debts and payment defaults hardly matter for the credit assessment, or imply that credit replaces savings or raises the standard of living.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the consumer when a personalised credit offer is based entirely on automated processing
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:1011, Konsumentkreditlag (2026:1011), 2 kap. 7 §

titles.en: Tell the consumer when a personalised credit offer is based entirely on automated processing

summaries.en: If a personalised credit offer is based wholly on automated processing of personal data, the consumer must be told so clearly and understandably.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the consumer standardised pre-contract credit information in good time
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:1011, Konsumentkreditlag (2026:1011), 3 kap. 1, 2 och 3 §§

titles.en: Give the consumer standardised pre-contract credit information in good time

summaries.en: Before a credit agreement is concluded, the trader must give the consumer the prescribed information, in good time and using the Standard European Consumer Credit Information form, on paper or another durable medium.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out a thorough creditworthiness assessment in the consumer's interest before granting credit
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:1011, Konsumentkreditlag (2026:1011), 3 kap. 13 och 14 §§

titles.en: Carry out a thorough creditworthiness assessment in the consumer's interest before granting credit

summaries.en: The trader must thoroughly assess, in the consumer's interest, whether the consumer can meet the obligations under the agreement, based on verified information about the consumer's income, expenses, debts and other necessary financial circumstances, and may grant the credit only if so. A new assessment is required before any significant increase.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Offer human review and an explanation when the credit assessment uses automated processing
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:1011, Konsumentkreditlag (2026:1011), 3 kap. 15 §

titles.en: Offer human review and an explanation when the credit assessment uses automated processing

summaries.en: If the creditworthiness assessment involves automated processing of personal data, the trader must, at the consumer's request and with human involvement, review the assessment, explain it and the weight of the automated processing, and inform about the risks, and must tell the consumer about these rights.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep interest and total credit costs within the statutory caps
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:1011, Konsumentkreditlag (2026:1011), 4 kap. 4 och 5 §§

titles.en: Keep interest and total credit costs within the statutory caps

summaries.en: Credit and default interest may not exceed the reference rate plus 20 percentage points a year, and total credit costs, including default interest and collection costs, may not exceed the amount of the credit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Detect consumers' payment difficulties early and offer forbearance before enforcement
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:1011, Konsumentkreditlag (2026:1011), 6 kap. 11 och 12 §§

titles.en: Detect consumers' payment difficulties early and offer forbearance before enforcement

summaries.en: The creditor must have procedures to detect early when a consumer has difficulty meeting the agreement and then point the consumer to budget and debt advice, and, where a consumer is in arrears and it is appropriate, must offer alternatives to enforcement that change the agreement, taking the consumer's circumstances into account.

instruments.title: Add Lag om verksamhet med bostadskrediter, SFS 2016:1024
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1024, Lag (2016:1024) om verksamhet med bostadskrediter, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1022

titles.en: Act (2016:1024) on mortgage credit business

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, fairly, transparently and professionally in mortgage lending
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1024, Lag (2016:1024) om verksamhet med bostadskrediter, 4 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Act honestly, fairly, transparently and professionally in mortgage lending

summaries.en: Creditors and credit intermediaries must act honestly, fairly, transparently and professionally, taking account of the consumer's rights and interests, and base their business on information about the consumer's circumstances and reasonable assumptions about the risks to the consumer over the life of the credit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure that mortgage staff have adequate knowledge and competence
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1024, Lag (2016:1024) om verksamhet med bostadskrediter, 4 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Ensure that mortgage staff have adequate knowledge and competence

summaries.en: Creditors and intermediaries must have staff, including those who manage the work, with sufficient knowledge and competence to design, offer, grant or intermediate mortgage credit agreements or give advice on them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Design staff pay so it does not undermine the duty to act in the consumer's interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1024, Lag (2016:1024) om verksamhet med bostadskrediter, 4 kap. 3, 4 och 5 §§

titles.en: Design staff pay so it does not undermine the duty to act in the consumer's interest

summaries.en: Remuneration for staff who design, offer, grant or advise on mortgage credit, and for those assessing creditworthiness, must not harm the duty of fair conduct, must promote sound risk management and must not impair advisers' ability to act in the consumer's best interest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Base mortgage advice on up-to-date information about the consumer and recommend only suitable credit
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1024, Lag (2016:1024) om verksamhet med bostadskrediter, 4 kap. 8 och 9 §§

titles.en: Base mortgage advice on up-to-date information about the consumer and recommend only suitable credit

summaries.en: Advice on mortgage credit must start from current information about the consumer's financial and personal situation, preferences and needs, consider a sufficiently large number of credit agreements, and recommend only agreements suitable for the consumer.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Set lending guidelines and value residential collateral under predetermined standards
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2016:1024, Lag (2016:1024) om verksamhet med bostadskrediter, 4 kap. 11 och 12 §§

titles.en: Set lending guidelines and value residential collateral under predetermined standards

summaries.en: The creditor must set and apply lending guidelines, including what property it accepts as collateral, and when valuing a consumer's home used as collateral must apply predetermined guidelines with reliable standards, using a sufficiently independent valuer. From 20 November 2026 these duties are renumbered 4 kap. 14 and 15 §§.

instruments.title: Add Lag om begränsning av bostadskrediter, SFS 2026:226
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:226, Lag (2026:226) om begränsning av bostadskrediter, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1028

titles.en: Act (2026:226) on limits on mortgage credit

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the loan-to-value ratio at or below 90 per cent on new mortgages and 80 per cent on top-ups
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:226, Lag (2026:226) om begränsning av bostadskrediter, 3, 4, 5 och 13 §§

titles.en: Keep the loan-to-value ratio at or below 90 per cent on new mortgages and 80 per cent on top-ups

summaries.en: The creditor must calculate a loan-to-value ratio when a mortgage is granted for a home purchase or increased, and ensure it is at most 90 per cent when the credit is granted and at most 80 per cent when it is increased, using the market value at purchase or an allowed revaluation.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Require annual amortisation on mortgages with a loan-to-value ratio above 50 per cent
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:226, Lag (2026:226) om begränsning av bostadskrediter, 7, 9 och 10 §§

titles.en: Require annual amortisation on mortgages with a loan-to-value ratio above 50 per cent

summaries.en: A mortgage with a loan-to-value ratio above 50 and up to 70 per cent must be amortised by at least 1 per cent of the highest credit amount a year, and above 70 per cent by at least 2 per cent, subject to the exemptions the act allows, such as newly built homes and special reasons.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the borrower, on request, the data behind the amortisation requirement and loan-to-value ratio
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2026:226, Lag (2026:226) om begränsning av bostadskrediter, 14 §

titles.en: Give the borrower, on request, the data behind the amortisation requirement and loan-to-value ratio

summaries.en: On request the creditor must promptly give the borrower, or someone the borrower names, the information on which the amortisation requirement and loan-to-value ratio are calculated, and must be able to receive such requests and provide the data electronically and in another suitable way.

instruments.title: Add LVF, SFS 2004:46
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, text as amended up to SFS 2026:916

titles.en: Securities Funds Act (2004:46)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage each fund solely in the common interest of the unitholders
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, 4 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Manage each fund solely in the common interest of the unitholders

summaries.en: The fund management company represents the unitholders in all matters concerning the fund and, when managing it, must act solely in the unitholders' common interest.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep sound procedures for management, accounting, internal control and ICT systems
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, 2 kap. 17 §

titles.en: Keep sound procedures for management, accounting, internal control and ICT systems

summaries.en: A fund management company must have sound procedures for running the business and its accounting, for internal control and for operating its network and information systems, the last in line with DORA.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Spread each fund's investments and keep to the statutory investment limits
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, 5 kap. 1 och 6 §§

titles.en: Spread each fund's investments and keep to the statutory investment limits

summaries.en: Each fund must have an appropriate spread of investments given its investment focus, may invest only in the eligible liquid assets the act lists, and must keep within the issuer limits, generally 5 per cent of the fund's value in securities and money market instruments from a single issuer, with the exceptions the act sets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have a risk management system that measures fund positions at all times and report on it to Finansinspektionen
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, 5 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Have a risk management system that measures fund positions at all times and report on it to Finansinspektionen

summaries.en: The company must have a risk management system that lets it monitor and assess at any time the risk of each fund's positions and their effect on the fund's risk profile, must not rely solely or mechanically on credit ratings, and must regularly report on its risk management to Finansinspektionen.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Redeem fund units on request when the fund is open, at least twice a month
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, 4 kap. 13 §

titles.en: Redeem fund units on request when the fund is open, at least twice a month

summaries.en: A fund unit must be redeemed at the holder's request when the fund is open for redemption, which must be at least twice a month at reasonable intervals, or monthly where justified by unitholders' interests, with any notice period no longer than ten banking days and payment made as soon as possible.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep an up-to-date prospectus and key information document for each fund and provide them to investors
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, 4 kap. 15, 16 a och 20 §§

titles.en: Keep an up-to-date prospectus and key information document for each fund and provide them to investors

summaries.en: Each fund must have a current prospectus with the fund rules, risk profile and other information needed to assess the fund, and a current key information document that is fair, clear and not misleading. These documents and the latest reports must be provided free on request, and the key information document must be given in good time before an investment.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish an annual report within four months and a half-yearly report within two months for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, 4 kap. 18 §

titles.en: Publish an annual report within four months and a half-yearly report within two months for each fund

summaries.en: For each fund the company must produce an annual report within four months of the financial year end and a half-yearly report within two months of the half-year end, with the information needed to assess the fund's performance and position, and send them free to unitholders on request.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell each unitholder every year the costs charged to their holding
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, 4 kap. 22 §

titles.en: Tell each unitholder every year the costs charged to their holding

summaries.en: Each year the company must tell every unitholder in writing how much of the fund's total costs in the previous year relate to their holding, showing the share that is management costs including custody.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As depositary, act independently for unitholders, monitor fund cash flows and hold fund assets in custody
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2004:46, Lag (2004:46) om värdepappersfonder, 3 kap. 2, 5 och 6 §§

titles.en: As depositary, act independently for unitholders, monitor fund cash flows and hold fund assets in custody

summaries.en: A depositary must act honestly, fairly, independently and professionally and solely in the unitholders' common interest, manage conflicts of interest, monitor the fund's cash flows, hold in custody the fund's financial instruments that can be registered or delivered, and verify ownership of and keep a record of its other assets.

instruments.title: Add LAIF, SFS 2013:561
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1070

titles.sv: Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder
titles.en: Act (2013:561) on managers of alternative investment funds

obligations.title: Add the duty: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the best interest of the funds and their investors
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, 8 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Act honestly, fairly and professionally in the best interest of the funds and their investors

summaries.en: When running its business an AIF manager must act honestly, fairly, professionally and in the best interests of the funds it manages and their investors, uphold public confidence in the market, and have and use effectively the resources and procedures needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Manage liquidity so each fund's liquidity profile matches its obligations and stress test it regularly
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, 8 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Manage liquidity so each fund's liquidity profile matches its obligations and stress test it regularly

summaries.en: An AIF manager must have appropriate liquidity management systems and procedures for monitoring liquidity risk so that each fund's liquidity profile matches its underlying obligations, and must carry out regular stress tests of each fund's liquidity under exceptional conditions. This does not apply to unleveraged closed-ended funds.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Select at least two liquidity management tools for each open-ended fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, 8 kap. 3 a och 3 d §§

titles.en: Select at least two liquidity management tools for each open-ended fund

summaries.en: For each open-ended alternative investment fund it manages, the AIF manager must choose at least two of the liquidity management tools listed in the act that can be used in the investors' interest, and notify Finansinspektionen when a tool is activated. Under the transitional rules, a manager must tell Finansinspektionen of the tools chosen no later than 30 December 2026.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a risk management function separate from the operating units
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, 8 kap. 4 §

titles.en: Keep a risk management function separate from the operating units

summaries.en: An AIF manager must have a risk management function that is functionally and hierarchically separate from its operating units and appropriate risk management systems to identify, measure, manage and monitor the risks of each fund.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure proper and independent valuation of each fund's assets
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, 8 kap. 7 och 8 §§

titles.en: Ensure proper and independent valuation of each fund's assets

summaries.en: For each fund the manager must ensure appropriate and consistent procedures for a proper and independent valuation of the fund's assets and for calculating the net asset value per unit or share, in line with the law of the fund's home country and its rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Avoid, identify, manage and disclose conflicts of interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, 8 kap. 19 §

titles.en: Avoid, identify, manage and disclose conflicts of interest

summaries.en: An AIF manager must take all reasonable steps to avoid conflicts of interest and to identify, manage and disclose those that nevertheless arise, and must have organisational and administrative arrangements that stop conflicts harming the fund or its investors.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Appoint a depositary for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, 9 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Appoint a depositary for each fund

summaries.en: For each alternative investment fund it manages, the manager must ensure that a depositary is appointed, and must replace a depositary established in a third country that becomes listed as high-risk or non-cooperative as the act sets out.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a current prospectus and publish an annual report within six months for each fund
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, 10 kap. 1 och 4 §§

titles.en: Keep a current prospectus and publish an annual report within six months for each fund

summaries.en: For each EEA fund managed and each fund marketed in the EEA, the manager must keep a current information prospectus covering, among other things, the investment strategy, risk profile and leverage, liquidity and redemption terms and all fees and costs, and make an annual report available within six months of the financial year end to investors on request and to Finansinspektionen.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform investors regularly about illiquid assets, liquidity arrangements and the fund's risk profile
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2013:561, Lag (2013:561) om förvaltare av alternativa investeringsfonder, 10 kap. 9 §

titles.en: Inform investors regularly about illiquid assets, liquidity arrangements and the fund's risk profile

summaries.en: For each fund managed or marketed in the EEA, the manager must regularly tell investors the share of illiquid assets, changes in liquidity management, the current risk profile and risk management systems, and the other matters the act lists.

instruments.title: Add FRL, SFS 2010:2043
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), text as amended up to SFS 2026:635

titles.en: Insurance Business Act (2010:2043)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Run the insurance business with adequate solidity, liquidity and control of risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 4 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Run the insurance business with adequate solidity, liquidity and control of risks

summaries.en: The insurer must conduct its business with solidity, liquidity and control over insurance, investment and operational risks that are satisfactory for its size and nature, so that it can meet its commitments to policyholders and other beneficiaries.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give policyholders clear information on terms and value development and follow good insurance practice
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 4 kap. 2 och 3 §§

titles.en: Give policyholders clear information on terms and value development and follow good insurance practice

summaries.en: Information to policyholders and prospective policyholders must suit the type of insurance and clearly show its terms and value development, other beneficiaries must get the information they need, and the business must be run in line with good insurance practice.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Invest assets prudently and in the policyholders' interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 6 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Invest assets prudently and in the policyholders' interest

summaries.en: The insurer's assets must be invested prudently under the act's investment rules, and where interests conflict the assets must be invested in the way that best serves policyholders and other beneficiaries.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Finansinspektionen immediately if the solvency capital requirement is not met or may not be met within three months
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 8 kap. 12 §

titles.en: Notify Finansinspektionen immediately if the solvency capital requirement is not met or may not be met within three months

summaries.en: The insurer must tell Finansinspektionen immediately if it does not meet the solvency capital requirement or there is a risk of this in the coming three months, and if it would fall short without the transitional measures it uses.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain an effective system of governance with written policies
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 10 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Maintain an effective system of governance with written policies

summaries.en: The insurer must have a system of governance that ensures sound and prudent management, review it regularly, and adopt and follow written policies for risk management, internal control, internal audit and the other areas the act lists.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Have risk management, compliance, internal audit and actuarial functions
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 10 kap. 4 §

titles.en: Have risk management, compliance, internal audit and actuarial functions

summaries.en: The insurer must have functions for risk management, compliance and internal audit and an actuarial function.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Ensure board members, managers and key function holders are fit and proper and notify changes
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 10 kap. 5 §

titles.en: Ensure board members, managers and key function holders are fit and proper and notify changes

summaries.en: The insurer must ensure that board members, the managing director, their deputies and those responsible for or working in key functions meet the fitness and propriety requirements, and notify Finansinspektionen as soon as possible of changes in these persons.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out an own risk and solvency assessment at least once a year and report it to Finansinspektionen
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 10 kap. 11, 12 och 13 §§

titles.en: Carry out an own risk and solvency assessment at least once a year and report it to Finansinspektionen

summaries.en: The insurer must carry out an own risk and solvency assessment covering its overall solvency needs and continuous compliance with capital requirements, at least annually and after any significant change in its risk profile, and report the results of each assessment to Finansinspektionen.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Finansinspektionen before outsourcing critical functions or activities
