obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 10 kap. 21 §

titles.en: Notify Finansinspektionen before outsourcing critical functions or activities

summaries.en: Before an agreement to outsource critical or important operational activities or functions takes effect, the insurer must notify Finansinspektionen, and it must also notify material changes as soon as possible.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish a solvency and financial condition report every year
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2010:2043, Försäkringsrörelselag (2010:2043), 16 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Publish a solvency and financial condition report every year

summaries.en: The insurer must publish a solvency and financial condition report once a year covering its business and performance, system of governance, risk profile, valuation for solvency purposes and solvency position, and update it in the cases the act sets.

instruments.title: Add LFD, SFS 2018:1219
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:1219, Lag (2018:1219) om försäkringsdistribution, text as amended up to SFS 2026:250

titles.en: Insurance Distribution Act (2018:1219)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Distribute insurance in line with good practice and look after the customer's interests
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:1219, Lag (2018:1219) om försäkringsdistribution, 4 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Distribute insurance in line with good practice and look after the customer's interests

summaries.en: An insurance distributor must follow good insurance distribution practice, safeguard the customer's interests with due care, act honestly, fairly and professionally, tailor advice to the customer's wishes and needs and recommend only suitable solutions.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not accept remuneration that works against the customer's interest
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:1219, Lag (2018:1219) om försäkringsdistribution, 4 kap. 3 och 5 §§

titles.en: Do not accept remuneration that works against the customer's interest

summaries.en: A distributor may not accept remuneration from anyone other than the customer that could prevent it from acting in line with good distribution practice and the customer's interest, and its staff remuneration must not conflict with that duty.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep internal controls and records showing that the distributor and its staff meet the competence and fitness requirements
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:1219, Lag (2018:1219) om försäkringsdistribution, 4 kap. 6 §

titles.en: Keep internal controls and records showing that the distributor and its staff meet the competence and fitness requirements

summaries.en: The distributor must have procedures and guidelines for internal control that it and its employees meet the requirements on knowledge, competence and reputation, keep records of the measures taken and appoint persons responsible for this.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Approve insurance products through a product oversight process with a defined target market
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:1219, Lag (2018:1219) om försäkringsdistribution, 4 kap. 7 och 8 §§

titles.en: Approve insurance products through a product oversight process with a defined target market

summaries.en: A distributor that manufactures insurance products must set, apply and review a product approval process covering new products and significant changes, identify a target market for each product and assess the relevant risks, before the product is marketed or distributed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Let customers complain in a suitable way and handle complaints effectively and promptly
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:1219, Lag (2018:1219) om försäkringsdistribution, 4 kap. 15 §

titles.en: Let customers complain in a suitable way and handle complaints effectively and promptly

summaries.en: The distributor must ensure that customers and others affected can file complaints in an appropriate way, that complaint handling is effective, and that complaints are answered as soon as possible.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the customer before the contract who the distributor is, who supervises it, whether it advises and how to complain
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:1219, Lag (2018:1219) om försäkringsdistribution, 5 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Tell the customer before the contract who the distributor is, who supervises it, whether it advises and how to complain

summaries.en: In good time before an insurance contract is concluded, the distributor must inform the customer of its identity and address and whether it is an intermediary or an insurer, the supervising authorities, whether it gives advice, and the ways to complain or settle disputes.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give retail customers a standardised product information document for non-life insurance
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:1219, Lag (2018:1219) om försäkringsdistribution, 5 kap. 13 §

titles.en: Give retail customers a standardised product information document for non-life insurance

summaries.en: When distributing a non-life insurance product to a consumer, the distributor must give the standardised insurance product information document on paper or another durable medium in good time before the contract is concluded.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Document what happened at the point of sale and give the documentation to the customer
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:1219, Lag (2018:1219) om försäkringsdistribution, 5 kap. 21 §

titles.en: Document what happened at the point of sale and give the documentation to the customer

summaries.en: The distributor must document what took place when the insurance was distributed and provide that documentation to the customer.

instruments.title: Add Lag om tjänstepensionsföretag, SFS 2019:742
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2019:742, Lag (2019:742) om tjänstepensionsföretag, text as amended up to SFS 2026:641

titles.en: Act (2019:742) on occupational pension undertakings

obligations.title: Add the duty: Send each member an annual pension benefit statement
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2019:742, Lag (2019:742) om tjänstepensionsföretag, 4 kap. 3 §

titles.en: Send each member an annual pension benefit statement

summaries.en: An occupational pension undertaking must each year give those entitled to benefits under an occupational pension insurance a pension statement showing their individual benefits and where more information is available.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Invest prudently and in the best interest of members and beneficiaries
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2019:742, Lag (2019:742) om tjänstepensionsföretag, 6 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Invest prudently and in the best interest of members and beneficiaries

summaries.en: The undertaking's assets must be invested prudently and in line with the act's investment rules, in the way that best serves policyholders, members and other beneficiaries.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold assets covering the technical provisions at all times
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2019:742, Lag (2019:742) om tjänstepensionsföretag, 6 kap. 12 och 13 §§

titles.en: Hold assets covering the technical provisions at all times

summaries.en: The undertaking must hold assets for covering technical provisions amounting at least to the technical provisions, invested appropriately given the nature and duration of the obligations.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold own funds that cover the risk-sensitive capital requirement at all times
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2019:742, Lag (2019:742) om tjänstepensionsföretag, 7 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Hold own funds that cover the risk-sensitive capital requirement at all times

summaries.en: In addition to covering assets, the undertaking must at all times have sufficient own funds, at least equal to the risk-sensitive capital requirement and never less than the higher of the minimum capital requirement and the guarantee amount.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Maintain a sound system of governance with risk management, compliance, internal audit and actuarial functions
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2019:742, Lag (2019:742) om tjänstepensionsföretag, 9 kap. 1 och 8 §§

titles.en: Maintain a sound system of governance with risk management, compliance, internal audit and actuarial functions

summaries.en: The undertaking must have a system of governance ensuring sound and prudent management, reviewed regularly, and functions for risk management, compliance and internal audit and an actuarial function.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out and document an own risk assessment at least annually and report it to Finansinspektionen
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2019:742, Lag (2019:742) om tjänstepensionsföretag, 9 kap. 20, 21 och 22 §§

titles.en: Carry out and document an own risk assessment at least annually and report it to Finansinspektionen

summaries.en: The undertaking must carry out and document its own risk and solvency assessment at least once a year and after significant changes in its risk profile, and report the result of each assessment to Finansinspektionen.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify Finansinspektionen of outsourcing agreements before they take effect
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2019:742, Lag (2019:742) om tjänstepensionsföretag, 9 kap. 25 §

titles.en: Notify Finansinspektionen of outsourcing agreements before they take effect

summaries.en: The undertaking must notify Finansinspektionen of an outsourcing agreement before it takes effect, and of material changes affecting the outsourced activities.

instruments.title: Add FAL, SFS 2005:104
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2005:104, Försäkringsavtalslag (2005:104), text as amended up to SFS 2026:1210

titles.en: Insurance Contracts Act (2005:104)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the customer information that helps assess the need for cover before consumer or personal insurance is taken out
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2005:104, Försäkringsavtalslag (2005:104), 2 kap. 2 § och 10 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Give the customer information that helps assess the need for cover before consumer or personal insurance is taken out

summaries.en: Before issuing consumer insurance or personal insurance, the insurer must give information that helps the customer judge the need for insurance and choose, summarising the main terms needed to assess cost and scope and making important limitations clear.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Confirm a personal insurance contract in writing promptly and highlight unexpected limitations
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2005:104, Försäkringsavtalslag (2005:104), 10 kap. 4 §

titles.en: Confirm a personal insurance contract in writing promptly and highlight unexpected limitations

summaries.en: As soon as possible after a personal insurance contract is concluded, the insurer must send the policyholder a written confirmation and, unless done earlier, explain the terms, highlighting unexpected and material limitations of cover.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Handle claims without delay and pay compensation no later than one month after the claim is documented
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2005:104, Försäkringsavtalslag (2005:104), 7 kap. 1 § och 16 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Handle claims without delay and pay compensation no later than one month after the claim is documented

summaries.en: Once notified of an insured event, the insurer must take the necessary steps without delay and settle the claim promptly with due regard to the claimant's interests, paying non-periodic compensation within one month of the claim and the reasonable investigation being presented.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not refuse personal insurance normally offered to the public without special reasons
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2005:104, Försäkringsavtalslag (2005:104), 11 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Do not refuse personal insurance normally offered to the public without special reasons

summaries.en: An insurer may not refuse anyone personal insurance of a kind it normally offers the public, once it has the information it needs, unless there are special reasons relating to the risk of future claims, the type of insurance or other circumstances.

instruments.title: Add Dataskyddslagen, SFS 2018:218
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:218, Lag (2018:218) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s dataskyddsförordning, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1589

titles.sv: Lag (2018:218) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s dataskyddsförordning
titles.en: Act (2018:218) with supplementary provisions to the EU General Data Protection Regulation

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the data protection officer bound to confidentiality
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:218, Lag (2018:218) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s dataskyddsförordning, 1 kap. 8 §

titles.en: Keep the data protection officer bound to confidentiality

summaries.en: A person acting as data protection officer under Article 37 of the GDPR must not disclose without authority what they have learned while carrying out the task.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Process personal data about criminal offences only where the act, government rules or an authority decision allows it
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:218, Lag (2018:218) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s dataskyddsförordning, 3 kap. 8 och 9 §§

titles.en: Process personal data about criminal offences only where the act, government rules or an authority decision allows it

summaries.en: Outside public authorities, personal data about criminal convictions and offences may be processed only where needed to comply with archive rules or where government regulations or an individual decision of the designated authority allow it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Use personal identity numbers without consent only when clearly justified
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2018:218, Lag (2018:218) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s dataskyddsförordning, 3 kap. 10 §

titles.en: Use personal identity numbers without consent only when clearly justified

summaries.en: Personal identity numbers and coordination numbers may be processed without consent only when clearly justified by the purpose of the processing, the importance of secure identification or another significant reason.

instruments.title: Add Lag om insättningsgaranti, SFS 1995:1571
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1571, Lag (1995:1571) om insättningsgaranti, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1061

titles.en: Deposit Guarantee Act (1995:1571)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply to the guarantee authority to have each deposit account type assessed for coverage
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1571, Lag (1995:1571) om insättningsgaranti, 3 b §

titles.en: Apply to the guarantee authority to have each deposit account type assessed for coverage

summaries.en: The institution must apply to the deposit guarantee authority for an assessment of whether the terms of each account type used to take deposits mean it is covered by the guarantee, and apply again before changing terms unless the change clearly does not matter.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform depositors whether and how their deposits are covered by the guarantee
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1571, Lag (1995:1571) om insättningsgaranti, 11 §

titles.en: Inform depositors whether and how their deposits are covered by the guarantee

summaries.en: Institutions taking deposits must tell existing and prospective depositors whether the deposit is covered, the outcome of the account-type assessment, the level of cover and how compensation is paid, in marketing and before a deposit agreement is concluded.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell depositors at least one month before a merger or restructuring that may affect their cover
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1571, Lag (1995:1571) om insättningsgaranti, 11 b §

titles.en: Tell depositors at least one month before a merger or restructuring that may affect their cover

summaries.en: Before a merger or other restructuring of the institution that may affect depositors' right to compensation, the institution must inform them at least one month before it takes effect.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Accept deposits from anyone unless there are special reasons not to
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1571, Lag (1995:1571) om insättningsgaranti, 11 d §

titles.en: Accept deposits from anyone unless there are special reasons not to

summaries.en: An institution that offers to take deposits must accept them from anyone unless there are special reasons against it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay the annual guarantee fee and provide audited data on deposits to the guarantee authority
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1571, Lag (1995:1571) om insättningsgaranti, 12, 13 och 16 §§

titles.en: Pay the annual guarantee fee and provide audited data on deposits to the guarantee authority

summaries.en: Each covered institution must pay an annual fee to the deposit guarantee authority, based on its covered deposits, within a month of the decision, and must provide the auditor-reviewed data needed to set the fee as well as, without delay, the data on depositors and deposits the authority needs.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Provide the data and assistance the guarantee authority needs to pay out compensation
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1571, Lag (1995:1571) om insättningsgaranti, 17 §

titles.en: Provide the data and assistance the guarantee authority needs to pay out compensation

summaries.en: When the right to compensation arises, the institution or its bankruptcy administrator must give the guarantee authority the data it needs to pay depositors and otherwise assist it with the payout.

instruments.title: Add Lag om resolution, SFS 2015:1016
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:1016, Lag (2015:1016) om resolution, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1073

titles.en: Resolution Act (2015:1016)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities that the Swedish National Debt Office sets
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:1016, Lag (2015:1016) om resolution, 4 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Meet the minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities that the Swedish National Debt Office sets

summaries.en: The Swedish National Debt Office, as resolution authority, sets for each institution a minimum requirement for own funds and eligible liabilities that can be written down or converted, and the institution must meet it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Notify the Debt Office immediately if the combined buffer requirement on top of MREL is not met
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:1016, Lag (2015:1016) om resolution, 4 kap. 30 §

titles.en: Notify the Debt Office immediately if the combined buffer requirement on top of MREL is not met

summaries.en: The firm must notify the Swedish National Debt Office immediately if it does not meet the combined buffer requirement in addition to the risk-weighted MREL ratio.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include bail-in recognition terms in third-country-law contracts for capital instruments and eligible liabilities
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:1016, Lag (2015:1016) om resolution, 5 kap. 2 och 3 a §§

titles.en: Include bail-in recognition terms in third-country-law contracts for capital instruments and eligible liabilities

summaries.en: In agreements for relevant capital instruments and eligible liabilities governed by third-country law, the institution must include terms under which creditors accept that the debt may be written down or converted in resolution, and tell the Debt Office where this is impracticable.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include resolution stay terms in third-country-law financial contracts
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:1016, Lag (2015:1016) om resolution, 5 kap. 9 §

titles.en: Include resolution stay terms in third-country-law financial contracts

summaries.en: In financial contracts governed by third-country law, the institution must include terms recognising that the contract may be subject to the temporary suspension powers and that resolution measures prevent exercising termination rights, as they would apply under Swedish law.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay the annual resolution fee
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:1016, Lag (2015:1016) om resolution, 27 kap. 13 §

titles.en: Pay the annual resolution fee

summaries.en: Fee-liable institutions must pay annual resolution fees to the resolution reserve, set in line with the EU regulation on resolution fees.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the Debt Office the information it requests for resolution planning
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:1016, Lag (2015:1016) om resolution, 28 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Give the Debt Office the information it requests for resolution planning

summaries.en: The institution and group companies must give the Swedish National Debt Office the information about their business it requests for its work under the act.

instruments.title: Add Lag om kapitalbuffertar, SFS 2014:966
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:966, Lag (2014:966) om kapitalbuffertar, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1071

titles.en: Capital Buffers Act (2014:966)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold common equity tier 1 capital covering the combined buffer requirement
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:966, Lag (2014:966) om kapitalbuffertar, 2 kap. 1 och 2 §§ och 3 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Hold common equity tier 1 capital covering the combined buffer requirement

summaries.en: The institution must hold common equity tier 1 capital equal to the combined buffer requirement, made up of the capital conservation buffer of 2.5 per cent of risk-weighted exposures, the institution-specific countercyclical buffer, any systemic risk buffer and any buffer for systemically important institutions, in addition to its other own funds requirements.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate and hold the institution-specific countercyclical buffer and be able to calculate the maximum distributable amount
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:966, Lag (2014:966) om kapitalbuffertar, 6 kap. 1, 2 och 7 §§

titles.en: Calculate and hold the institution-specific countercyclical buffer and be able to calculate the maximum distributable amount

summaries.en: The institution must hold a countercyclical buffer of common equity tier 1 capital equal to its total risk-weighted exposure times the weighted average of the applicable countercyclical buffer rates, also at group level, and must have methods to calculate its maximum distributable amount on an ongoing basis.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report the maximum distributable amount and file a capital conservation plan within five working days of a buffer breach
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:966, Lag (2014:966) om kapitalbuffertar, 8 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Report the maximum distributable amount and file a capital conservation plan within five working days of a buffer breach

summaries.en: An institution that does not meet the combined buffer requirement or the leverage ratio buffer must report its maximum distributable amount to Finansinspektionen and, within five working days of finding the breach, submit a capital conservation plan showing how it will restore the requirement within a reasonable time.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Restrict dividends, variable pay and AT1 coupons while a buffer requirement is not met
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:966, Lag (2014:966) om kapitalbuffertar, 8 kap. 3, 4 och 5 §§

titles.en: Restrict dividends, variable pay and AT1 coupons while a buffer requirement is not met

summaries.en: While a buffer requirement is not met, the institution may not make distributions linked to its capital, commit to or pay variable remuneration or discretionary pension benefits, or pay on additional tier 1 instruments, beyond its maximum distributable amount, and must notify Finansinspektionen before acting within that amount.

instruments.title: Add Lag om särskild tillsyn över kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, SFS 2014:968
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:968, Lag (2014:968) om särskild tillsyn över kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1081

titles.sv: Lag (2014:968) om särskild tillsyn över kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag
titles.en: Act (2014:968) on special supervision of credit institutions and investment firms

payload.shortName: Lag om särskild tillsyn över kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag

obligations.title: Add the duty: Meet the additional own funds and liquidity requirements Finansinspektionen sets
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:968, Lag (2014:968) om särskild tillsyn över kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, 2 kap. 1, 1 a, 1 b och 2 §§

titles.en: Meet the additional own funds and liquidity requirements Finansinspektionen sets

summaries.en: Finansinspektionen decides on special own funds requirements, for leverage risk and other risks, and where needed a special liquidity requirement, and the credit institution must meet them with capital of the quality the act prescribes.

obligations.title: Add the duty: As the responsible group entity, ensure solvency and risk management requirements are met on a consolidated basis
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:968, Lag (2014:968) om särskild tillsyn över kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, 3 kap. 2 §

titles.en: As the responsible group entity, ensure solvency and risk management requirements are met on a consolidated basis

summaries.en: The entity responsible for a consolidated situation must ensure that the banking act's requirements on soundness and risk management are met at group level in line with the CRR.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply to Finansinspektionen for approval as a financial holding company
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:968, Lag (2014:968) om särskild tillsyn över kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, 1 a kap. 1 §

titles.en: Apply to Finansinspektionen for approval as a financial holding company

summaries.en: A parent financial holding company or mixed financial holding company, and certain other holding companies that must meet the CRR, must apply to Finansinspektionen for approval or for exemption from approval.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give Finansinspektionen the information it requests for consolidated supervision
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:968, Lag (2014:968) om särskild tillsyn över kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, 6 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Give Finansinspektionen the information it requests for consolidated supervision

summaries.en: Firms under consolidated supervision and the other group companies the act names must provide Finansinspektionen with the information about their business it requests for supervision.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish the legal structure, governance and organisation of the consolidated situation
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2014:968, Lag (2014:968) om särskild tillsyn över kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, 6 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Publish the legal structure, governance and organisation of the consolidated situation

summaries.en: A parent company must publish information on the legal structure, governance and organisational structure of its consolidated situation.

instruments.title: Add Lag om finansiella konglomerat, SFS 2006:531
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2006:531, Lag (2006:531) om särskild tillsyn över finansiella konglomerat, text as amended up to SFS 2026:633

titles.sv: Lag (2006:531) om särskild tillsyn över finansiella konglomerat
titles.en: Act (2006:531) on special supervision of financial conglomerates

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hold own funds meeting the financial conglomerate's capital requirement
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2006:531, Lag (2006:531) om särskild tillsyn över finansiella konglomerat, 5 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Hold own funds meeting the financial conglomerate's capital requirement

summaries.en: A financial conglomerate must have own funds that meet the special capital requirement for conglomerates, and institutions, insurers and occupational pension undertakings in it must hold own funds sufficient for that requirement.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Calculate conglomerate capital continuously and report it to Finansinspektionen
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2006:531, Lag (2006:531) om särskild tillsyn över finansiella konglomerat, 5 kap. 10 §

titles.en: Calculate conglomerate capital continuously and report it to Finansinspektionen

summaries.en: The conglomerate's own funds and capital requirement must be calculated on an ongoing basis, and the results and the key data behind them reported regularly to Finansinspektionen.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report significant risk concentrations and intra-group transactions
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2006:531, Lag (2006:531) om särskild tillsyn över finansiella konglomerat, 5 kap. 11 §

titles.en: Report significant risk concentrations and intra-group transactions

summaries.en: Significant risk concentrations and intra-group transactions of the kinds Finansinspektionen decides for the conglomerate must be reported to it regularly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep risk management and internal control adequate for the conglomerate's overall risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2006:531, Lag (2006:531) om särskild tillsyn över finansiella konglomerat, 5 kap. 13 §

titles.en: Keep risk management and internal control adequate for the conglomerate's overall risks

summaries.en: Institutions, insurers and occupational pension undertakings in a financial conglomerate must have risk management systems and internal control procedures that are adequate given the conglomerate's overall risk situation.

instruments.title: Add Lag om säkerställda obligationer, SFS 2003:1223
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2003:1223, Lag (2003:1223) om utgivning av säkerställda obligationer, text as amended up to SFS 2026:627

titles.sv: Lag (2003:1223) om utgivning av säkerställda obligationer
titles.en: Act (2003:1223) on the issuance of covered bonds

obligations.title: Add the duty: Issue covered bonds only with a permit from Finansinspektionen
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2003:1223, Lag (2003:1223) om utgivning av säkerställda obligationer, 2 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Issue covered bonds only with a permit from Finansinspektionen

summaries.en: A credit institution may issue covered bonds only after Finansinspektionen has granted a permit, and the designation covered bond may be used only for debt instruments covered by the act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Value mortgage collateral individually and monitor its market value
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2003:1223, Lag (2003:1223) om utgivning av säkerställda obligationer, 3 kap. 4, 5 och 7 §§

titles.en: Value mortgage collateral individually and monitor its market value

summaries.en: When granting mortgage credit for the cover pool, the issuer must set the collateral's market value by an individual valuation by a competent valuer, documented, and must monitor market values, counting only the part of a loan within the permitted loan-to-value ratio if values fall significantly.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep the cover pool at least 2 per cent above outstanding covered bond claims
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2003:1223, Lag (2003:1223) om utgivning av säkerställda obligationer, 3 kap. 8 §

titles.en: Keep the cover pool at least 2 per cent above outstanding covered bond claims

summaries.en: The nominal value of the cover pool must at all times exceed the nominal value of claims on the issuer under covered bonds by at least 2 per cent and also cover the costs of administering and winding down the bonds in bankruptcy.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Match cover pool terms to the bonds and keep a 180-day liquidity buffer in the pool
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2003:1223, Lag (2003:1223) om utgivning av säkerställda obligationer, 3 kap. 9 och 9 a §§

titles.en: Match cover pool terms to the bonds and keep a 180-day liquidity buffer in the pool

summaries.en: The cover pool's currency, interest and fixed-rate terms must be balanced against those of the covered bonds, and the pool must hold a liquidity buffer of high-quality assets covering the maximum cumulative net liquidity outflow for the next 180 days.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep a register of covered bonds, cover pool assets and derivatives
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2003:1223, Lag (2003:1223) om utgivning av säkerställda obligationer, 3 kap. 10 och 11 §§

titles.en: Keep a register of covered bonds, cover pool assets and derivatives

summaries.en: The issuer must keep a register of the covered bonds, the cover pool and any derivative contracts, showing at all times their nominal values and the funds deriving from the pool, with the details the act lists for each bond and credit.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give buyers the information needed to assess a covered bond and its risks
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2003:1223, Lag (2003:1223) om utgivning av säkerställda obligationer, 3 kap. 16 §

titles.en: Give buyers the information needed to assess a covered bond and its risks

summaries.en: The issuer must provide the information about a covered bond that a buyer needs to assess the bond and the risk of investing in it, including, for bonds with extendable maturity, the triggers for extension, the effect of bankruptcy or resolution and the need for Finansinspektionen's approval.

instruments.title: Add ÅRKL, SFS 1995:1559
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1559, Lag (1995:1559) om årsredovisning i kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, text as amended up to SFS 2026:781

titles.sv: Lag (1995:1559) om årsredovisning i kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag
titles.en: Act (1995:1559) on annual accounts of credit institutions and investment firms

obligations.title: Add the duty: Include a capital adequacy analysis in the annual report
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1559, Lag (1995:1559) om årsredovisning i kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, 2 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Include a capital adequacy analysis in the annual report

summaries.en: Credit institutions and investment firms covered by the act on special supervision must include a capital adequacy analysis in their annual report.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Prepare consolidated accounts each year as a parent institution
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1559, Lag (1995:1559) om årsredovisning i kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, 7 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Prepare consolidated accounts each year as a parent institution

summaries.en: Credit institutions and investment firms that are parent companies, and the financial holding companies the act covers, must prepare consolidated accounts under this act for each financial year unless an exemption applies.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish at least one interim report in each financial year
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1995:1559, Lag (1995:1559) om årsredovisning i kreditinstitut och värdepappersbolag, 9 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Publish at least one interim report in each financial year

summaries.en: At least once during a financial year longer than ten months, the institution must produce an interim report under the act.

instruments.title: Add Lag om nödlidande kreditavtal, SFS 2023:714
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2023:714, Lag (2023:714) om förvärv och förvaltning av nödlidande kreditavtal, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1027

titles.sv: Lag (2023:714) om förvärv och förvaltning av nödlidande kreditavtal
titles.en: Act (2023:714) on the purchase and servicing of non-performing credit agreements

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the buyer the necessary information on a non-performing loan and its collateral before transfer
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2023:714, Lag (2023:714) om förvärv och förvaltning av nödlidande kreditavtal, 2 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Give the buyer the necessary information on a non-performing loan and its collateral before transfer

summaries.en: Before transferring a non-performing credit agreement, the credit institution must give the purchaser the information needed about the agreement and any collateral securing it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report sales of non-performing loans to Finansinspektionen
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2023:714, Lag (2023:714) om förvärv och förvaltning av nödlidande kreditavtal, 2 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Report sales of non-performing loans to Finansinspektionen

summaries.en: A credit institution that has transferred non-performing credit agreements must inform Finansinspektionen of the purchaser's and its representative's identity and address, the number and size of the loans transferred and the other details the act lists.

instruments.title: Add Riksbankslagen, SFS 2022:1568
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2022:1568, Lag (2022:1568) om Sveriges riksbank, text as amended up to SFS 2026:1078

titles.en: Sveriges Riksbank Act (2022:1568)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Plan to keep payment services running in peacetime crises and heightened alert, and train staff
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2022:1568, Lag (2022:1568) om Sveriges riksbank, 5 kap. 6 §

titles.en: Plan to keep payment services running in peacetime crises and heightened alert, and train staff

summaries.en: A company whose business is of particular importance for carrying out payments must plan and prepare to continue its payment-related activities during peacetime crises and heightened alert, take part in the Riksbank's crisis management work, and give its staff and contractors the training and exercises needed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the Riksbank the information it requests
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2022:1568, Lag (2022:1568) om Sveriges riksbank, 12 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Give the Riksbank the information it requests

summaries.en: On the Riksbank's request, financial firms must provide the information necessary for the Riksbank's tasks under the act, and firms of particular importance for payments must provide what it needs for its preparedness tasks.

instruments.title: Add SFL, SFS 2011:1244
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), text as amended up to SFS 2026:1305

titles.en: Tax Procedure Act (2011:1244)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Withhold preliminary tax from interest and dividends paid to Swedish tax residents
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 10 kap. 2, 15, 16 och 17 §§

titles.en: Withhold preliminary tax from interest and dividends paid to Swedish tax residents

summaries.en: Whoever pays out taxable interest, dividends or other returns must withhold preliminary tax at each payment, and tax must be withheld from cash interest and dividends that are reported under the control statement rules, subject to the exceptions the act lists, for example for small amounts of account interest and for persons with limited tax liability.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File control statements on interest paid or credited to individuals by 31 January
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 17 kap. 1, 2 och 3 §§ och 24 kap. 1 §

titles.en: File control statements on interest paid or credited to individuals by 31 January

summaries.en: Legal persons that credit or pay interest or other returns on claims to individuals or estates must file a control statement with Skatteverket for each calendar year, by 31 January of the following year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File control statements on interest received from individual borrowers by 31 January
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 18 kap. 1, 2 och 3 §§ och 24 kap. 1 §

titles.en: File control statements on interest received from individual borrowers by 31 January

summaries.en: Legal persons that receive interest from individuals or estates, such as mortgage interest, must file a control statement on those interest expenses with Skatteverket by 31 January of the following year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File control statements on interest and dividends on shares paid to individuals
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 19 kap. 1, 2, 3 och 4 §§ och 24 kap. 1 §

titles.en: File control statements on interest and dividends on shares paid to individuals

summaries.en: Whoever credits or pays interest, dividends or other returns on shares and similar equity rights to individuals or estates must file a control statement with Skatteverket by 31 January of the following year, except for assets on an investment savings account or pension savings account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: File control statements on disposals of fund units, shares, debt instruments and derivatives
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 20 kap. 1, 3 och 5 §§ och 21 kap. 1, 3 och 4 §§

titles.en: File control statements on disposals of fund units, shares, debt instruments and derivatives

summaries.en: Fund companies, depositaries and securities institutions that take part in disposals must file control statements on redemptions and disposals of fund units and on disposals of other shares, debt claims and derivative transactions as the act allocates the duty, except for holdings on an investment savings account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report US reportable accounts to Skatteverket by 15 May
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 22 a kap. 2 och 3 §§ och 24 kap. 2 a §

titles.en: Report US reportable accounts to Skatteverket by 15 May

summaries.en: Reporting financial institutions must file control statements on accounts that are reportable under the FATCA identification act, and they must reach Skatteverket by 15 May of the following year.

payload.refLabel: 22 a kap. 2 och 3 §§ och 24 kap. 2 a §

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report CRS reportable and undocumented accounts to Skatteverket by 15 May
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 22 b kap. 2 och 3 §§ och 24 kap. 2 a §

titles.en: Report CRS reportable and undocumented accounts to Skatteverket by 15 May

summaries.en: Reporting financial institutions must file control statements on accounts that are reportable, and on undocumented accounts, under the act on identification of reportable accounts for automatic exchange, and they must reach Skatteverket by 15 May of the following year.

payload.refLabel: 22 b kap. 2 och 3 §§ och 24 kap. 2 a §

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report reportable crypto-asset users and transactions to Skatteverket by 1 April
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 22 d kap. 3 § och 24 kap. 2 b §

titles.en: Report reportable crypto-asset users and transactions to Skatteverket by 1 April

summaries.en: A reporting crypto-asset service provider must file control statements on reportable crypto-asset users and their transactions, which must reach Skatteverket by 1 April of the following year.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report reportable cross-border tax arrangements to Skatteverket within 30 days as an intermediary
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 33 b kap. 10, 12 och 19 §§

titles.en: Report reportable cross-border tax arrangements to Skatteverket within 30 days as an intermediary

summaries.en: An intermediary with a Swedish connection must report reportable cross-border arrangements to Skatteverket within 30 days from the day after the arrangement was made available, was ready for implementation or implementation began, unless another intermediary has already reported it.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Report cross-border payments to Skatteverket each quarter when a payee receives more than 25 payments
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1244, Skatteförfarandelag (2011:1244), 33 c kap. 5, 6 och 10 §§

titles.en: Report cross-border payments to Skatteverket each quarter when a payee receives more than 25 payments

summaries.en: A payment service provider serving a payer or payee in Sweden must report cross-border payments to Skatteverket where a single payee receives at least 26 payments in a calendar quarter, by the end of the month after the quarter, subject to the rule on which provider reports.

instruments.title: Add Lag om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton (CRS), SFS 2015:911
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:911, Lag (2015:911) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton vid automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar om finansiella konton, text as amended up to SFS 2025:1386

titles.sv: Lag (2015:911) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton vid automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar om finansiella konton
titles.en: Act (2015:911) on identification of reportable accounts for the automatic exchange of financial account information

payload.shortName: Lag om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton (CRS)
payload.implementsNote: Directive 2014/107/EU and Directive (EU) 2023/2226 amending Directive 2011/16/EU; the multilateral competent authority agreement on automatic exchange of financial account information

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a tax residence self-certification from individuals before opening an account
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:911, Lag (2015:911) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton vid automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar om finansiella konton, 5 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Obtain a tax residence self-certification from individuals before opening an account

summaries.en: Before an individual opens a new account, the reporting financial institution must obtain a self-certification of the states or jurisdictions where the person is tax resident, check it against other information, and obtain a new one if it has reason to believe the self-certification is unreliable.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain self-certifications from entities on tax residence and passive status before opening an account
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:911, Lag (2015:911) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton vid automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar om finansiella konton, 7 kap. 2, 3 och 4 §§

titles.en: Obtain self-certifications from entities on tax residence and passive status before opening an account

summaries.en: Before an entity opens a new account, the institution must obtain a self-certification to establish the entity's tax residence and whether it is a passive non-financial entity, relying on its anti-money laundering customer due diligence to identify controlling persons.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Review pre-existing individual and entity accounts for reportable holders
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:911, Lag (2015:911) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton vid automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar om finansiella konton, 4 kap. 1, 2 och 5 §§ och 6 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Review pre-existing individual and entity accounts for reportable holders

summaries.en: The institution must review pre-existing individual accounts, with a residence address test or electronic record search for lower-value accounts and enhanced review for high-value accounts, and review pre-existing entity accounts, to identify reportable accounts.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register with Skatteverket within two months of becoming a reporting financial institution
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:911, Lag (2015:911) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton vid automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar om finansiella konton, 8 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Register with Skatteverket within two months of becoming a reporting financial institution

summaries.en: A financial institution that meets the criteria of a reporting financial institution must notify Skatteverket as soon as possible and no later than two months after, and notify when it no longer meets them.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep due diligence records for five years after an account is closed
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:911, Lag (2015:911) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton vid automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar om finansiella konton, 8 kap. 9 §

titles.en: Keep due diligence records for five years after an account is closed

summaries.en: Documents and data on the measures taken to identify whether an account is reportable must be kept for at least five years after the account is closed.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell individuals when a breach of data security is likely to harm their data or privacy
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:911, Lag (2015:911) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton vid automatiskt utbyte av upplysningar om finansiella konton, 8 kap. 10 §

titles.en: Tell individuals when a breach of data security is likely to harm their data or privacy

summaries.en: The reporting institution must inform the individuals concerned when a breach or weakness in the protection of the data has occurred that is likely to adversely affect their personal data or privacy.

instruments.title: Add Lag om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton enligt FATCA-avtalet, SFS 2015:62
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:62, Lag (2015:62) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton med anledning av FATCA-avtalet, text as amended up to SFS 2025:1385

titles.sv: Lag (2015:62) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton med anledning av FATCA-avtalet
titles.en: Act (2015:62) on identification of reportable accounts under the FATCA agreement

payload.shortName: Lag om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton enligt FATCA-avtalet
payload.implementsNote: The FATCA agreement between the governments of Sweden and the United States

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain a self-certification of US tax residence before an individual opens an account
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:62, Lag (2015:62) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton med anledning av FATCA-avtalet, 5 kap. 1 §

titles.en: Obtain a self-certification of US tax residence before an individual opens an account

summaries.en: Before an individual opens a new account, the reporting financial institution must obtain a self-certification giving the facts needed to decide whether the person is resident in the United States for tax purposes, and act on it if it shows US residence.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register with the US tax authority as a FATCA-compliant financial institution
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:62, Lag (2015:62) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton med anledning av FATCA-avtalet, 8 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Register with the US tax authority as a FATCA-compliant financial institution

summaries.en: A reporting financial institution must be registered with the US Internal Revenue Service as a financial institution deemed to comply with the FATCA rules.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep FATCA due diligence records for five years after an account is closed
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2015:62, Lag (2015:62) om identifiering av rapporteringspliktiga konton med anledning av FATCA-avtalet, 8 kap. 8 §

titles.en: Keep FATCA due diligence records for five years after an account is closed

summaries.en: Documents and data on the measures taken to identify whether an account is reportable must be kept for at least five years after the account is closed.

instruments.title: Add Lag om rapporteringspliktiga arrangemang, SFS 2020:434
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2020:434, Lag (2020:434) om rapporteringspliktiga arrangemang, text as amended up to SFS 2020:558

titles.en: Act (2020:434) on reportable arrangements

payload.implementsNote: Directive 2011/16/EU on administrative cooperation in taxation, as amended (reportable cross-border arrangements)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Assess cross-border arrangements against the hallmarks to decide whether they must be reported
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2020:434, Lag (2020:434) om rapporteringspliktiga arrangemang, 5 och 12 §§

titles.en: Assess cross-border arrangements against the hallmarks to decide whether they must be reported

summaries.en: A cross-border arrangement is reportable if it shows any of the hallmarks the act lists, and for some hallmarks only if obtaining a tax advantage is the main or one of the main benefits. Firms acting as intermediaries or users must identify such arrangements so they can meet the reporting duty in the Tax Procedure Act.

instruments.title: Add Lag om uppgifter om kryptotillgångar på skatteområdet, SFS 2025:1377
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2025:1377, Lag (2025:1377) om inhämtande av vissa uppgifter på skatteområdet om kryptotillgångar, text as issued

titles.sv: Lag (2025:1377) om inhämtande av vissa uppgifter på skatteområdet om kryptotillgångar
titles.en: Act (2025:1377) on the collection of certain tax information on crypto-assets

payload.shortName: Lag om uppgifter om kryptotillgångar på skatteområdet

obligations.title: Add the duty: Obtain and check a tax residence self-certification from each crypto-asset user
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2025:1377, Lag (2025:1377) om inhämtande av vissa uppgifter på skatteområdet om kryptotillgångar, 7 kap. 2 och 3 §§

titles.en: Obtain and check a tax residence self-certification from each crypto-asset user

summaries.en: When establishing a relationship with an individual or entity user, a reporting crypto-asset service provider must obtain a self-certification allowing it to determine the user's tax residence and verify that it is reasonable against other information it holds. For existing users the self-certification must be obtained by 1 January 2027.

instruments.title: Add ISK-lagen, SFS 2011:1268
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1268, Lag (2011:1268) om investeringssparkonto, text as amended up to SFS 2026:909

titles.en: Investment Savings Account Act (2011:1268)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Open an investment savings account only for a single individual or estate, and never transfer it
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1268, Lag (2011:1268) om investeringssparkonto, 9 §

titles.en: Open an investment savings account only for a single individual or estate, and never transfer it

summaries.en: An investment savings account agreement may be made only between an investment firm and one individual or one estate, with terms consistent with the act; the account is held by one holder, kept by one firm, and may not be transferred.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Pay interest, dividends and sale proceeds directly into the investment savings account
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1268, Lag (2011:1268) om investeringssparkonto, 23 och 26 §§

titles.en: Pay interest, dividends and sale proceeds directly into the investment savings account

summaries.en: Interest, dividends and other returns on assets held on the account, and cash or eligible assets received on their sale, must be transferred directly to the investment savings account, with the exceptions the act sets for non-eligible assets.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Inform the customer before opening an account about fees, taxation and asset rules
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1268, Lag (2011:1268) om investeringssparkonto, 30 §

titles.en: Inform the customer before opening an account about fees, taxation and asset rules

summaries.en: Before concluding an investment savings account agreement, the firm must give information, in writing or another durable form, on fees, how the account is taxed and the tax collected, what eligible and non-eligible assets are, and how long and on what terms non-eligible assets may stay on the account.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Tell the holder within five days when non-eligible assets are held or the account has ceased to qualify
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2011:1268, Lag (2011:1268) om investeringssparkonto, 31 §

titles.en: Tell the holder within five days when non-eligible assets are held or the account has ceased to qualify

summaries.en: The firm must inform the account holder within five days of learning that non-eligible assets are held on the account or that it has ceased to be an investment savings account, and say by when such assets must be removed.

instruments.title: Add Lag med kompletterande bestämmelser till DORA, SFS 2024:1278
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2024:1278, Lag (2024:1278) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om digital operativ motståndskraft för finanssektorn, text as issued

titles.sv: Lag (2024:1278) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om digital operativ motståndskraft för finanssektorn
titles.en: Act (2024:1278) with supplementary provisions to the EU regulation on digital operational resilience for the financial sector

payload.shortName: Lag med kompletterande bestämmelser till DORA

obligations.title: Add the duty: Carry out threat-led penetration testing when and as often as Finansinspektionen decides
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2024:1278, Lag (2024:1278) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om digital operativ motståndskraft för finanssektorn, 2 kap. 1 och 2 §§

titles.en: Carry out threat-led penetration testing when and as often as Finansinspektionen decides

summaries.en: Finansinspektionen decides which financial entities must carry out threat-led penetration tests under Article 26 of DORA and how often; the Riksbank oversees and coordinates the tests and issues the attestations.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give the Riksbank the information it needs to oversee threat-led penetration testing
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2024:1278, Lag (2024:1278) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om digital operativ motståndskraft för finanssektorn, 2 kap. 4 §

titles.en: Give the Riksbank the information it needs to oversee threat-led penetration testing

summaries.en: On the Riksbank's request, financial entities must provide the information necessary for its oversight and coordination of threat-led penetration tests.

instruments.title: Add Cybersäkerhetslagen, SFS 2025:1506
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2025:1506, Cybersäkerhetslag (2025:1506), text as issued

titles.en: Cybersecurity Act (2025:1506)

obligations.title: Add the duty: Register as a covered entity with the designated authority and report changes within 14 days
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2025:1506, Cybersäkerhetslag (2025:1506), 1 kap. 4 och 10 §§ och 2 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Register as a covered entity with the designated authority and report changes within 14 days

summaries.en: An operator covered by the act, including an entity in a sector listed in the annexes to the NIS2 Directive (banking covers credit institutions) that meets the act's size and establishment criteria, must register with the authority the government designates as soon as possible and report changes no later than 14 days after they occur. Security measures and incident reporting under the act yield to equivalent sector rules such as DORA.

instruments.title: Add Lag med kompletterande bestämmelser till MiCA, SFS 2024:1159
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2024:1159, Lag (2024:1159) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om marknader för kryptotillgångar, text as amended up to SFS 2026:336

titles.sv: Lag (2024:1159) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om marknader för kryptotillgångar
titles.en: Act (2024:1159) with supplementary provisions to the EU regulation on markets in crypto-assets

payload.shortName: Lag med kompletterande bestämmelser till MiCA

obligations.title: Add the duty: Keep crypto-asset customers' business confidential
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2024:1159, Lag (2024:1159) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om marknader för kryptotillgångar, 1 kap. 4 §

titles.en: Keep crypto-asset customers' business confidential

summaries.en: Employees and contractors of a firm covered by MiCA must not disclose or use without authority what they learn about others' business or personal circumstances.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Hand over customer information to criminal investigators without delay and electronically
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2024:1159, Lag (2024:1159) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om marknader för kryptotillgångar, 1 kap. 5 §

titles.en: Hand over customer information to criminal investigators without delay and electronically

summaries.en: A firm covered by MiCA must provide information about individuals' relationships with it without delay and in electronic form when requested in a criminal investigation, forfeiture investigation, mutual legal assistance matter or European investigation order.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Give Finansinspektionen the information it requests for MiCA supervision
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2024:1159, Lag (2024:1159) med kompletterande bestämmelser till EU:s förordning om marknader för kryptotillgångar, 2 kap. 2 §

titles.en: Give Finansinspektionen the information it requests for MiCA supervision

summaries.en: Natural and legal persons must provide Finansinspektionen with the information it requests for its supervision under MiCA.

instruments.title: Add Lag om värdepapperscentraler och kontoföring, SFS 1998:1479
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1998:1479, Lag (1998:1479) om värdepapperscentraler och kontoföring av finansiella instrument, text as amended up to SFS 2025:317

titles.sv: Lag (1998:1479) om värdepapperscentraler och kontoföring av finansiella instrument
titles.en: Act (1998:1479) on central securities depositories and the account-based registration of financial instruments

payload.implementsNote: Shareholder Rights Directive, Directive 2007/36/EC (identification of shareholders)

obligations.title: Add the duty: As account operator, document the basis for registrations and keep it for ten years
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1998:1479, Lag (1998:1479) om värdepapperscentraler och kontoföring av finansiella instrument, 3 kap. 6 c §

titles.en: As account operator, document the basis for registrations and keep it for ten years

summaries.en: An account operator must document, and keep for at least ten years, the data underlying the registration measures it takes in the CSD register.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Disclose shareholder identity to the issuer on request and pass requests down the chain
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1998:1479, Lag (1998:1479) om värdepapperscentraler och kontoföring av finansiella instrument, 3 a kap. 3 och 4 §§

titles.en: Disclose shareholder identity to the issuer on request and pass requests down the chain

summaries.en: An intermediary must, on request of a company whose shares it holds, provide without delay information on the shareholders, including name, identification number, address and holdings, and must forward the request without delay to the next intermediary if it does not hold the information itself.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Facilitate shareholders' exercise of their rights and transmit company information without delay
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1998:1479, Lag (1998:1479) om värdepapperscentraler och kontoföring av finansiella instrument, 3 a kap. 8 och 9 §§

titles.en: Facilitate shareholders' exercise of their rights and transmit company information without delay

summaries.en: An intermediary must facilitate the exercise of rights by shareholders, either by enabling them to act themselves or by acting on their explicit instructions, and must transmit without delay the information companies must provide to shareholders and the confirmations related to voting.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Publish charges for shareholder services separately, non-discriminatory and cost-based
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 1998:1479, Lag (1998:1479) om värdepapperscentraler och kontoföring av finansiella instrument, 3 a kap. 14 §

titles.en: Publish charges for shareholder services separately, non-discriminatory and cost-based

summaries.en: Charges an intermediary levies for the shareholder identification and rights services must be published separately for each service, be non-discriminatory and be proportionate to actual costs.

instruments.title: Add Lag om konto- och värdefackssystem, SFS 2020:272
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2020:272, Lag (2020:272) om konto- och värdefackssystem, text as amended up to SFS 2026:123

titles.en: Act (2020:272) on the account and safe-deposit-box system

obligations.title: Add the duty: Make account and safe deposit box holder data available to Skatteverket's account register system
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2020:272, Lag (2020:272) om konto- och värdefackssystem, 1, 2 och 8 §§

titles.en: Make account and safe deposit box holder data available to Skatteverket's account register system

summaries.en: Credit institutions and investment firms that hold client funds on accounts must give access, through the technical platform Skatteverket provides, to data on the holders and representatives of accounts and safe deposit boxes, so that it is directly and immediately searchable by the authorities the act names. How institutions give access is set in regulations under the act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Do not reveal to the customer that an authority has searched the account register
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2020:272, Lag (2020:272) om konto- och värdefackssystem, 3 b §

titles.en: Do not reveal to the customer that an authority has searched the account register

summaries.en: The institution, its board members and employees must not disclose without authority to the customer or anyone else that an authority has searched the account and safe-deposit-box system.

instruments.title: Add Lag om internationella sanktioner, SFS 2025:327
instruments.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2025:327, Lag (2025:327) om internationella sanktioner, text as issued

titles.en: International Sanctions Act (2025:327)

payload.implementsNote: Directive (EU) 2024/1226 on criminal offences and penalties for the violation of Union restrictive measures

obligations.title: Add the duty: Freeze listed persons' assets and do not make funds available to them or circumvent sanctions
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2025:327, Lag (2025:327) om internationella sanktioner, 3 och 5 §§

titles.en: Freeze listed persons' assets and do not make funds available to them or circumvent sanctions

summaries.en: It is a crime, committed intentionally or through gross negligence, to make property available to listed persons or entities, to fail to freeze their property, or to carry out transactions or otherwise breach or circumvent prohibitions and obligations in EU sanctions regulations or rules under the act.

obligations.title: Add the duty: Apply Finansinspektionen's interim freezing decisions for new UN listings
obligations.sourceLabel: Riksdagen, Svensk författningssamling, SFS 2025:327, Lag (2025:327) om internationella sanktioner, 20 §

titles.en: Apply Finansinspektionen's interim freezing decisions for new UN listings

summaries.en: When the UN Security Council or a sanctions committee decides a freeze that the EU is to implement by amending an existing regulation, Finansinspektionen decides corresponding measures, published in Post- och Inrikes Tidningar, which apply until the EU acts.
